protocol: R27-Q query-conditioned candidate pooling (NEXT_DESIGN_CN.md, review f3640384, 2026-10-31)
frozen_before: any formal unit and before the GPU gate of the frozen snapshot; no DEV result of any R27-Q arm was seen
base: code_cs (R27-CS) C-native arm cn_mix_t2i; diff Q_DIFF.patch; r27cs_sources.py unchanged

arms.q2_vcs_pool: relation head, original VCS J(T), T=tanh(g)
arms.q4_snce_pool: same head, soft-NCE t2i in-batch competition, logits 2g (uncapped)

relation_head.features: concat(q*y, |q-y|, q.y) of unit teacher vectors (2*1024+1 = 2049 inputs)
relation_head.init: PyTorch default Linear init under torch.manual_seed(stage_seed+17); identical initial head for Q2/Q3/Q4

link.vcs: T = tanh(g); maximize J = E_P[T - T^2/2] - E_Q[T + T^2/2]
link.snce: minimize -sum_l soft[k,l] log softmax_l(2 g(cap_k, img_l)) over the P batch (rows = captions); soft = observed-image-ID duplicates, rows normalized

relation_head.shared_optimum: VCS/BCE: g* = 0.5 log(p/q); NCE: 2g* = log(p/q) + c(query); softmax(2g*) over candidates = normalized density ratio

P.definition: stage labeled split (teacher's GMM clean split as handed to the stage) rows with teacher clean prob > teacher avg_clean_prob; caption -> OBSERVED image
P.weighting: uniform within the stage (one peer stage = one time window)
P.split_rule: n_val = min(N_VAL, floor(n/10) to a multiple of 128); n_fit = min(N_FIT, rest to a multiple of 128); random subset (stage seed)

Q.definition: empirical product of the fitted P marginals including its diagonal: caption and image indices drawn independently uniformly from the fitted P rows
Q.per_step: BATCH x BATCH grid of independent draws
Q.nce: uses the P batch itself (in-batch competition), same index draws consumed

teacher_coordinates.teacher: other peer (net2) eval mode, no grad
teacher_coordinates.centering_fit: per 128-pair encoding chunk of P, each modality by its chunk mean, then l2norm
teacher_coordinates.centering_apply: query captions by the noisy batch own (unaugmented, teacher-eval) caption mean; candidates by the teacher-eval mean of the noisy batch observed images; then l2norm

stage_schedule.when: start of every peer stage (model A with teacher B, then model B with teacher A), each epoch
stage_schedule.rng: torch.random.fork_rng (global CPU/CUDA RNG restored); numpy/python RNG untouched

readout.alpha: softmax(beta * score) over the K=5 candidates of each row
readout.note: alpha is a relative candidate weight, not a calibrated clean probability

trial.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

rules.steps: smallest S in STEPS_GRID such that, for EACH of the three heads, the held-out improvement of its own objective (loss at step 0 minus loss at S) is >= 0.95 x its best improvement over STEPS_GRID; one S for all heads
rules.beta: temperature scaling on held-out high-confidence pairs (training-visible observed pairing only): each held-out caption gets K=5 candidates = its observed image + the 4 other distinct observed images of the held-out pool with highest teacher cosine; NLL(beta) = -mean log softmax(beta*score)[observed]; BETA_HEAD = argmin over BETA_GRID of the SUM of the Q2/Q3/Q4 NLLs (one shared value); BETA_COS = argmin over BETA_GRID of the Q1 cosine NLL
rules.data: gate start state, stage A of the next epoch (teacher = model B), GMM split recomputed as in training

trial.observation_info_only: calibration set (observed + 4 cosine-nearest distractors): observed top1 cos 0.662 vcs 0.611 bce 0.605 snce 0.632

config.FEATURES: concat(q*y, |q-y|, q.y) of unit teacher vectors (2*1024+1 = 2049 inputs)

TRIAL_RULES.steps: smallest S in STEPS_GRID such that, for EACH of the three heads, the held-out improvement of its own objective (loss at step 0 minus loss at S) is >= 0.95 x its best improvement over STEPS_GRID; one S for all heads
TRIAL_RULES.beta: temperature scaling on held-out high-confidence pairs (training-visible observed pairing only): each held-out caption gets K=5 candidates = its observed image + the 4 other distinct observed images of the held-out pool with highest teacher cosine; NLL(beta) = -mean log softmax(beta*score)[observed]; BETA_HEAD = argmin over BETA_GRID of the SUM of the Q2/Q3/Q4 NLLs (one shared value); BETA_COS = argmin over BETA_GRID of the Q1 cosine NLL
TRIAL_RULES.data: gate start state, stage A of the next epoch (teacher = model B), GMM split recomputed as in training

revisions.code: r27q_pool.fit_head: opt_h.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) after the fit (frozen head kept its last fit-step .grad; not in any optimizer, params unchanged by the encoder step). No numeric change; all hyperparameters/rules unchanged.
revisions.gate_script: v2: weighted-uniform route param criterion 1e-6 -> 1e-5 (observed 1.08e-6 = fp32 rounding through one AdamW step; the bitwise mean route is unchanged), threshold check compares with the fp32 mean as computed in R.main (v1 compared a float64 mean at 1e-9). v1 kept as gate/r27q_gate.py.v1_1078152.
